name: compass-mcp
description: Compass real-estate access for Claude — search listings, resolve addresses, fetch property details, photos and price history, compare homes, and run mortgage/affordability math

compass_communities_file.title: Communities file
compass_communities_file.description: Path to a JSON string-array of community names for feature extraction; overrides the built-in Lake Lure / mountain-NC default vocabulary.

tools.name: compass_search_properties
tools.description: Search Compass listings by location and optional filters

tools.name: compass_get_property
tools.description: Fetch a property's full details by Compass URL or listing_id_sha

tools.name: compass_get_property_photos
tools.description: The full photo gallery for a Compass listing

tools.name: compass_get_price_history
tools.description: Listing and prior-listing history (listed / sold / price changes) for a Compass property

tools.name: compass_compare_properties
tools.description: Fetch several Compass properties and align their facts side-by-side

tools.name: compass_bulk_get
tools.description: Fetch up to 200 Compass listings by URL or listing_id_sha in one call

tools.name: compass_get_by_address
tools.description: Resolve a street address to a Compass listing's URL and identifiers

tools.name: compass_resolve_addresses
tools.description: Resolve many street addresses to Compass listings in one call

tools.name: compass_get_comparable_rentals
tools.description: Nearby rental listings for a Compass property

tools.name: compass_get_agent_listings
tools.description: A Compass agent's active (and optionally closed) listings

tools.name: compass_get_saved_homes
tools.description: The signed-in user's favorited homes (not yet supported — returns an explanatory error)

tools.name: compass_get_saved_searches
tools.description: The signed-in user's saved searches (not yet supported — returns an explanatory error)

tools.name: compass_calculate_mortgage
tools.description: Local PITI mortgage-payment calculator — no network

tools.name: compass_healthcheck
tools.description: Confirm the browser bridge, extension and signed-in compass.com tab are responsive

tools.name: compass_get_session_context
tools.description: List registered logical sessions and the active one

tools.name: compass_register_session
tools.description: Register or refresh a logical session keyed by account identity
